promotionPolicy: Every threshold must pass. No post-hoc threshold changes after model outputs are inspected; changing thresholds requires a new calibration version.
notes: Gold labels come from controlled seeded mutations and deliberately withheld evidence, not from another model's approval.
Clean controls are frozen snapshots from deterministically certified Unit 1 content.
Additional justified FAIL/UNCERTAIN criteria on defect cases are allowed; the seeded expected criterion must still be detected as FAIL.
Generic public benchmarks do not override Vajefy-specific calibration results.
